publicSkills.description: User-invoked command to plan, install, or maintain self-hosted apps from names or replacement goals, with Homarr and private credential handoff.
publicSkills.compatibility: Requires Git and Bun 1.4.0 or newer; deployment also needs Docker and agent-browser.

workflows.description: Base supporting planning router. Use from the self-host entry point to resolve goals, compare services, and produce short, composable, read-only plans from the curated catalog. Include Homarr as the standard private control plane.
workflows.compatibility: Requires Bun 1.4.0 or newer for bundled planning scripts; host mutation remains capability-owned and approval-gated.

workflows.description: Optional backup extension. Plan and assess secret-free backup and restore protection for self-hosted services. Use for data classification, encrypted targets, retention, immutability, consistency hooks, RPO/RTO, alerts, or isolated restore evidence. This capability plans and evaluates evidence; it does not run, prune, overwrite, or restore backups.
workflows.compatibility: Requires Bun 1.4.0 or newer for the bundled planner; accepts redacted JSON facts only.

workflows.description: Base apply capability. Validate, plan, render, preflight, and apply one explicitly owned Docker Compose project. Use for project IDs, pinned images, private ports, bind paths, networks, opaque secret references, deterministic rendering, idempotent `up`, or scoped `stop`. Ownership, privilege, exposure, and mutation stay explicitly gated.
workflows.compatibility: Planning requires Bun 1.4.0 or newer; approved lifecycle actions require Docker with Compose v2.

workflows.description: Base control-plane adapter. Set up Homarr v2 as the standard private dashboard and read-only agent gateway for a selected stack. Use for Homarr onboarding, integration graphs, API-key profiles, `/api/mcp`, client setup, generated-dashboard evidence, or Seerr title search that stops before requesting.
workflows.compatibility: Requires Bun 1.4.0 or newer; live API checks need an explicitly identified private Homarr endpoint and secret reference.

workflows.description: Base inspection capability. Inspect and plan a self-hosting host without mutation. Use before deployment, migration, or troubleshooting to identify the platform, Docker context, bounded containers and networks, listeners, filesystems, numeric identity, or safe paths across macOS, Linux, Unraid, TrueNAS SCALE, and Proxmox. Return redacted facts and non-secret recommendations only.
workflows.compatibility: Requires POSIX shell tooling on macOS or Linux; Docker inspection is optional and remains read-only.

workflows.description: Optional ingress extension. Plan private-first ingress and remote access for self-hosted services. Use for local or LAN access, tailnets, reverse proxies, tunnels, DNS, TLS, ports 80/443, authentication, ownership conflicts, or separate public-exposure approval. This capability produces a redacted plan and does not configure the edge.
workflows.compatibility: Requires Bun 1.4.0 or newer for the bundled planner; provider configuration stays outside this read-only capability.

workflows.description: Media pack adapter. Use only when directly requested or delegated by explicit selfhost-setup or selfhost-upkeep to set up, synchronize, and verify the exact private owned-content stack of Seerr, Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr, qBittorrent, Jellyfin, and Homarr.
workflows.compatibility: Planning requires Bun 1.4.0 or newer and Bash; approved harness runs require Docker Compose and browser evidence requires agent-browser.

workflows.description: Optional observability extension. Create and assess read-only observability plans for self-hosted services. Use for process state, API readiness, dependencies, edge health, storage, backup freshness, logs, metrics, alerts, ownership, or minimal reuse. Keep planned, configured, and observed state distinct and report only supplied redacted evidence.
workflows.compatibility: Requires Bun 1.4.0 or newer for the bundled planner; accepts redacted facts and evidence only.

workflows.description: Base operations capability. Plan bounded upgrades, migrations, rollbacks, and troubleshooting for one owned self-hosted Compose project. Use for version or schema changes, recovery, compatibility, backup/restore, health, acceptance, and rollback gates. Produce a secret-free plan and delegate every Compose mutation to `selfhost-compose`.
workflows.compatibility: Requires Bun 1.4.0 or newer for the bundled planner; execution is delegated to selfhost-compose.

workflows.description: Optional research extension. Research current self-hosted software without changing a host. Use for official installation or API evidence, secret-free Compose extraction, alternative comparisons, lifecycle or image provenance, documentation-link validation, Homarr coverage, or bounded public UI proof. Keep official and community evidence distinct.
workflows.compatibility: Requires Bun 1.4.0 or newer; live research may require approved public network or browser access.

workflows.description: Base setup workflow. Intentionally install prerequisites and carry one selected self-hosted stack through plan, approval, apply, browser configuration, verification, metadata recording, and access handoff. Internal workflow loaded for requested setup.
workflows.compatibility: Requires Bun 1.4.0 or newer; apply needs the selected runtime, and browser setup uses agent-browser.

workflows.description: Base upkeep workflow. Intentionally resume, inspect, extend, upgrade, repair, or re-verify a stack recorded by selfhost-setup. Internal workflow for continuing work on an existing `.selfhost/stack.json` project.
workflows.compatibility: Requires Bun 1.4.0 or newer plus the setup skill and the runtime recorded by the stack.

workflows.description: Base verification capability. Independently aggregate secret-free acceptance evidence without mutation. Use after planning or apply to assess source class, expected and actual classifications, timestamps, hashes, freshness, missing or conflicting evidence, public ingress, VPN fail-closed behavior, restore proof, media graphs, or Homarr claims. Emit claims only from supplied evidence.
workflows.compatibility: Requires Bun 1.4.0 or newer; evaluates local redacted evidence documents without probing the target.

workflows.description: Optional downloader VPN extension. Plan and assess downloader-only VPN isolation. Use for Gluetun or WireGuard gateway topology, keeping management services outside the namespace, LAN control allowlists, opaque secret references, DNS or egress leak evidence, and a hard tunnel-break test. Produce a provider-neutral read-only plan for authorized content only.
workflows.compatibility: Requires Bun 1.4.0 or newer for the bundled planner; live tunnel testing is a separate approved verification step.
